compliance_decision:
1. The Reserve Bank, after consulting with the Prudential Authority, determines countercyclical buffer levels for systemically important financial institutions or generally applicable to such institutions in relation to specified matters including capital requirements related to counter-cyclical buffers.
2. Section (a) of Source 1: "Solvency measures and capital requirements, which may include require- ments in relation to counter- cyclical capital buffers," as amended by the Banking Amendment Act 2017 No 45 - Parliamentary Debates (Hansard) (New Zealand : eighth session, Fourth Parliament), 6 November 2017, column MR39.
3. The Reserve Bank has authority to impose requirements on systemically important financial institutions or generally applicable banks in relation to capital buffers that are counter-cyclical as part of solvency measures and broader capital requirement regulations after consulting with the Prudential Authority, according to Section (a) of Source 1.
4. Yes
